Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human kappa-type opioid receptor (CHEMBL237). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL237 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
